providerCatalogScope: Operating LLM API provider and relay-station sites only, in three product categories: model-vendor, third-party (commercial aggregators / cloud MaaS / inference hosts, not relays), and relay (community/grey/personal). Listing is not endorsement. Open-source backends such as one-api/new-api are detected attributes, not catalog entries.
source: Agent Atlas verified application catalog; 2026-11-12 add Buzz desktop, kwant desktop and self-hosted Web (3 records / 2 products; 579 records / 398 products; 237 SVG files / 92 PNG files after update; based on v0.47 @ a5d1ca2 after #36). Provider catalog unchanged (170 providers, 3-type taxonomy).
verificationScope: Official website/source review; not an installation or availability test
openSourceMetadataScope: Verified per record ID; missing metadata means unverified, not closed-source. Repository pushes do not prove maintenance.
interactionModel: One independent application record per interaction form: GUI, CLI, IDE 插件, Web, 浏览器插件, 小程序. IM is a channel; DingTalk embedded AI capabilities belong to its GUI application.
applicationScope: Desktop and browser applications; mobile-only records excluded. Existing mini programs retained.
namingPolicy: Use CN where needed in product names. Application names omit added interaction-form suffixes; interfaces and platforms distinguish records. No edition field.
assetReview: OpenRouter candidate discovery 2026-10-11: public page snapshot, independently verified application forms, original SVG/PNG sources and hashes in docs/research/openrouter-review-2026-10-11.json. OpenRouter categories and opt-in token usage do not determine catalog identity, licensing or total market popularity.
logoPolicy: Original SVG and PNG accepted. PNG is explicitly marked raster; hasSvg and SVG counts only include .svg assets.
webDomainPolicy: web_domains is an array of verified exact user-facing application hostnames, separate from the official website. Shared hostnames may match multiple applications. No API/CDN/SSO inference or implicit subdomain matching; self-hosted/local instances have no universal public domain. Missing domains explicitly remain unverified.
